instrumentNote: Flying Fish 1017: chemical front, scientific back. Photographed row arrangement; modern chemistry and gas models, not a certified historical calibration. Both sides keeps their cursor and slide linked.

front.name: Front - chemical engineering
front.note: Mz/Xz is fixed; M/X moves. Xz is mass fraction and X mole fraction. Pressure is absolute: kgf/cm2 and mmHg/atm. F(t) uses modern air/CO2 models. The outer LnI-2/Ln-2 rows are near-unity exponentials, not linear logarithms.

back.name: Back - scientific calculation
back.note: Ln and LnI are natural-exponential log-log scales (positive and reciprocal), despite the different scale names. The lg row is the linear base-10 logarithm. Normalised 0-1 rule length; original end extensions and specialist gauge marks are not transcribed.
